researcher_notes: No roster row matches (no Samburg/Arcticgas row in GGIT snapshot 20260930; nearest are P0737-P0738 Bovanenkovo-Ukhta and P2459 Zapolyarnoye-Novy Urengoy, unrelated). Length 46 km SOURCED (>=25 km): glavportal.com Arcticgas profile (7 Apr 2016) states in 2012 the '46-километровый газопровод, который соединяет установку подготовки газа с Единой системой газоснабжения' alongside the Samburgskoye field start-up (April 2012; UKPG stages 1-2 commissioned within the year). Page names Samburgskoye field/UKPG, passes url_verifier. oilgasinform.ru field catalogue carries the same sentence verbatim (likely copied from the NOVATEK/Arcticgas release) - not independent, not cited. Tier medium: single media-piece ref, no primary NOVATEK/Arcticgas page located. NOT stated in any source found: diameter (left blank), tie-in trunk/node (EndLocation generic), capacity, route; no GIS (OSM 81 km figure is not supported and OSM is never a ref). Owner: entity_lookup finds no existing 'Arcticgas'/'Arktikgaz' entity (stage as new; Arcticgas is the NOVATEK-Gazprom Neft 50/50 JV licence holder); Parent entities Gazprom Neft PJSC exists, NOVATEK not found (new). Operator/owner of the pipe itself is inferred to be Arcticgas as field operator, not stated by the ref - confirm. PipelineType=transmission proposed (46 km export line from the UKPG to the UGSS, outside the field gathering system) with that reasoning; gathering is the alternative if reviewers treat producer export spurs as gathering - needs ruling. Separate 20 km condensate line to the Yurkharovskoye-Purovsky ZPK condensate pipeline is out of scope (not gas). | RULING 2026-09-30 (Claude, delegated by Baird): PipelineType=gathering - producer UKPG-to-UGSS tie-in, consistent with the other D3 field connections; owner (Arcticgas) inferred from field operator, not stated by the ref.
